tools.name: get_service_info
tools.description: Call this first when you are new to convert.express, before quoting a price to your user, or when unsure whether a file, link or language is supported. Returns one JSON object: how_to_use (which tool to call in which order), free_use, price (per minute, minimum charges), models, language, speaker_la

tools.name: estimate_cost
tools.description: Price for transcribing a recording of a given length (EUR, plus price_usdc when USDC is on). For a robot linked to its user's account it also shows the user's free minutes left today, balance and daily limit left.

tools.name: transcribe_url
tools.description: Start transcribing a media file from a public link (direct file link, YouTube video or Simplecast podcast episode page). Returns job_id and robot_key; then poll get_job.

tools.name: transcribe_file
tools.description: Start transcribing an audio or video file your user attached in a ChatGPT chat. ChatGPT fills in a temporary download link and convert.express downloads the file from it. Other chat apps cannot fill in that link: use create_upload for files attached there. Returns job_id; then poll get_job.

tools.name: create_upload
tools.description: For a file that is neither a public link nor attached in a ChatGPT chat (for example a file attached in another chat app). Returns upload_url (send the file there with an HTTP PUT, then call start_transcription) and upload_page_url (a page where your user uploads the file in a browser instead; the t

tools.name: start_transcription
tools.description: Call after the PUT to upload_url has finished. Checks the file arrived and queues it.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Status and results of one job whose job_id you have (from transcribe_url, transcribe_file or create_upload; list_jobs finds a lost job_id). While status is "waiting_for_upload", "queued" or "processing", call it again every 10-20 seconds; each answer has a next_step. "completed": the transcript in t

tools.name: pay_job
tools.description: Pay for the full transcript of a job whose get_job status is "payment_required", with USDC on Tempo or a card your user shared through a Stripe Shared Payment Token (MPP). Call without payment: you get a payment challenge with the exact price — in EUR for a card, in USDC for Tempo. Your MPP client p

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: Your jobs that still exist (jobs are deleted within 24 hours of being created), newest first, with their status.

tools.name: create_share_link
tools.description: A public web page with the results of a completed job, for your user to open or send to others. Anyone with the link can see it until the job expires.

tools.name: delete_job
tools.description: Delete the uploaded file, the transcript and all other results of a job right away, instead of waiting for the automatic deletion within 24 hours of its creation. Cannot be undone.

tools.name: request_summary
tools.description: Ask for an AI summary or action items of a completed job. Returns at once; the result appears in get_job ("summary" / "action_items").

tools.name: translate
tools.description: Translate the transcript, subtitles (timecodes kept), summary or action items of a completed job into another language. Returns at once; the result appears in get_job under "translations".

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Tell the convert.express team about a bug, a missing feature, or a question — from you or your user. A human reads every message; there is no automatic reply. Include reply_email only if your user wants an answer.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_job, pay_job, create_share_link · Private data: get_service_info, transcribe_url, transcribe_file, create_upload, start_transcription, get_job, pay_job, delete_job · Public sink: create_upload, create_share_link, send_feedback · Destructive: get_job, delete_job.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_job, pay_job, create_share_link · Private data: get_service_info, transcribe_url, transcribe_file, create_upload, start_transcription, get_job, pay_job, delete_job · Public sink: create_upload, create_share_link, send_feedback · Destructive: get_job, delete_job

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
